title: SchemaMigrationLedger
description: config/schema-migrations.yaml. One entry per SCHEMA_VERSION bump, declaring how much of the graph that version invalidates for clone-based migrations. Prepended (newest first) by `mise schema:bump`; humans may only widen an entry, never narrow it below the detected drift.

scope.description: '*' = full rebuild; 'sdlc' = SDLC-sourced tables (optionally narrowed by entities); 'code' = code-graph tables; 'none' = re-index nothing (certified output-neutral change; requires a note).

entities.description: SDLC entity names or relationship kinds narrowing a 'sdlc' scope. Only valid with scope 'sdlc'.

edge_rows.description: With scope 'sdlc', 'unchanged' declares that every edge row stays byte-identical, so the migration clones the edge tables instead of rebuilding them. Derived by `mise schema:bump`; absent means 'changed'.
